label: Freezer Control
info:
Controls multiple freezers via MQTT-switched power outlets. Each freezer's
internal thermostat is set to its minimum (~-25 degC), so the outlet is the
effective thermostat. The flow duty-cycles the outlets to minimise cost while
respecting a per-device hard temperature ceiling.

Optimisation inputs:
  - live PV (global.ess.pac, shared with battery controller)
  - current electricity price (flow.price_now, updated from MQTT)
  - price forecast (flow.price_forecast, updated from MQTT)
  - hourly PV curve (flow.pv_forecast_by_hour, from InfluxDB 30d mean)
  - weather (global.weather) - informational, feeds the PV curve sanity check
  - learned thermal model per freezer (cooling_rate, warming_rate, running_power)

Reused configs (same ids as appliance and battery controller flows):
  MQTT broker     mqtt_broker_config (192.168.4.221)
  InfluxDB live   influxdb_config_infra
  InfluxDB 2y     influxdb_config_infra_2y

Device wiring (placeholders - edit cfg.freezers to match your hardware):
  freezer_kitchen   temp  z2m/0xa0b1c2d3e4f50001   payload.temperature degC
                    pwr   tm/tele/FrzKitchen/SENSOR ENERGY.Power W
                    cmd   tm/cmnd/FrzKitchen/POWER  ON|OFF
  freezer_basement  temp  z2m/0xa0b1c2d3e4f50002   payload.temperature degC
                    pwr   tm/tele/FrzBasement/SENSOR ENERGY.Power W
                    cmd   tm/cmnd/FrzBasement/POWER ON|OFF
  freezer_garage    temp  z2m/0xa0b1c2d3e4f50003   payload.temperature degC
                    pwr   tm/tele/FrzGarage/SENSOR ENERGY.Power W
                    cmd   tm/cmnd/FrzGarage/POWER   ON|OFF

User API (MQTT):
  home/freezer/<name>/override  payload: ON | OFF | AUTO (retained)
  home/freezer/<name>/status    retained JSON status snapshot

State is kept in global.freezers[<name>] so other flows (monitoring, UI) can
read it. The thermal model is recomputed hourly from InfluxDB measurement
`freezer` (tag device, fields temperature and power) which this flow writes
on every reading.

NOTE: Tasmota's default TelePeriod (300s) gives coarse power data. Set
TelePeriod to ~30s on the freezer outlets for a better thermal model and
tighter completion detection.
